handoff_policy.global_context: Google Photorealistic remains authoritative from Earth through Benidoleig/parcel approach.
handoff_policy.preload_local: Keep aumara-site-v2_1.glb loaded but hidden while altitude is above 140 m AGL-equivalent/local transition altitude.
handoff_policy.transition_start: At parcel approach inside 220 m horizontal radius and below approximately 120 m above local origin, prepare local handoff but keep AR hidden.
handoff_policy.mobile_hard_handoff: On mobile/iPhone, once camera is inside 180 m local radius and below 90 m above local origin, set tileset.show=false and glb.show=true. Do not render Google and local terrain simultaneously inside the low-altitude local envelope.
handoff_policy.desktop_supported_clip: On desktop, clipping may remain active if stable; however below 70 m inside the local envelope the local twin is authoritative and Google tiles must not occlude/intersect the camera path.
handoff_policy.local_flight: WP0-WP27 at 3.5-4.0 m runs with local twin authoritative. Google may remain hidden until the local flight ends.
handoff_policy.restore: If guest exits/restarts back to global Earth stage, restore tileset.show=true before the next descent.

camera_and_visibility: Do not start WP0 while Google tileset is still visible on mobile.
Use a short 1-2 second spatial handoff window between ~120 m and ~70 m: local twin becomes visible only after Google is hidden or safely clipped.
Do not full-screen dissolve to a different camera. Keep the same Cesium camera/world coordinates.
Set window.__AUMARA.globalTilesVisible and localTwinVisible on every state transition for proof.
Handoff complete requires tileset.show===false (mobile low envelope), glb.show===true, and no fatalRenderError.
ar_gate: A-F labels remain hidden through Earth/parcel approach and during handoff.
Allow AR only after GOOGLE_LOCAL_HANDOFF_COMPLETE and camera is below 20 m above local terrain / in local envelope.
Do not show labels on top of coarse Google photogrammetry.
measurement: Once Google is hidden for local flight, groundSample must not call/sample Google terrain for local AGL proof.
Use LOCAL_TERRAIN_RAYCAST against the local twin terrain, fallback LOCAL_DEM only if no valid local hit.
Keep raw unclamped telemetry and the existing WP27 lifecycle fix.
